copy.tagline: 在后台定时发送网络请求检查服务状态
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要定期检测服务是否在线
copy.tagline_en: Send periodic network pings to check service status
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to periodically check if a service is online

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会在后台启动一个任务，同时继续处理其他工作。当后台任务有进展或完成时，系统会通过提醒通知你，你只需在收到提醒后检查输出文件即可。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 执行一个需要较长时间的任务，并指定 `run_in_background=true` 参数时触发。

say.text: 后台运行一个脚本，统计日志中的错误数，结果保存到 errors.md。
say.note: Claude 会继续与你对话，后台任务完成后通知你。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can launch a background agent and continue working on other tasks. The system notifies you via reminders when the agent makes progress or completes, and you only need to check the output file when notified.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to run a task with `run_in_background=true` parameter, indicating a long-running background job.

say_en.text: Analyze this report in background, output to .claude/cache/agents/report/output.md.
Run a script in background to count errors in logs, save results to errors.md.
say_en.note: Claude continues conversation and alerts you upon completion.
